name: Testimonials
summary: The AhaSlides marketing site testimonial sections: Simple left aligned and Case study cards (layouts of the Untitled UI testimonial sections the marketing team picked; layout only, no Untitled UI photo or asset) and Quote cards (the "What our users say" section of the ahaslides.com slide-type pages). Every placeholder is a real image file; every value comes from a DS token, component or marketing section (Cards, Features, Logos), and what the DS does not yet define is listed under Composed of as missing. Framework-free and bound to the shared --aha-* tokens.
highlights: Three layouts, each with its own labelled preview and paste-and-run snippet
Two backgrounds: White (the default) and Accent, the pale pink bgAccent surface laid over white by adding aha-testimonials--accent to the section; the cards stay white, so they read on both

Every placeholder (customer photo, case study covers) is an pointing at a real image file with alt text, and every avatar is with a photo src, never a drawn box or initials; the files and their sources are listed in marketing/images/testimonials/manifest.json

Rating is <aha-rate readonly size="sm">, avatars are <aha-avatar> (default 40), arrows are <aha-button variant="secondary" icon-only>; quote, name and role styles are the Testimonial card of the Cards page, the case study cards are its Case study card, and the section frame, header block and photo ratios are the Features section's

Case study cards are a native scroll-snap track with the DS secondary icon-only button for arrows; no autoplay, the track is focusable and scrolls with the arrow keys, and the small script only moves the track

Quote cards are three equal white cards (on the pale pink Accent background when you switch it on) that keep the avatar, name and role on one baseline whatever the quote length, and stack to one column at 767px

Company logos are trimmed copies of the Logos section data (marketing/data/logos-cms.json), kept in greyscale, all rendered at one fixed height with width auto, so every logo shares the same left edge and optical size
Each section is a container-query block stepping down at 991, 767 and 479px, with the Features section padding at each step

guidance.title: Choosing a background
guidance.intro: Every layout below has a White / Accent switch in its preview and a tab for each in its code.

points.title: White is the default
points.text: Use White unless the section needs to stand apart from the white sections around it. It is today's look and needs no extra class.

points.title: Accent
points.text: Add aha-testimonials--accent to the section. It lays the pale pink Accent background (bgAccent) over white, so it looks the same wherever it sits. The cards stay white; photos and avatars are unchanged.

points.title: Neighbours
points.text: Never place an Accent section next to another coloured section. Put it between white sections.
